defects: Boundedness hypotheses are swapped: h_sup guards f(sSup s) = sSup(f '' s) with BddBelow s, but sSup s is only meaningful (matches IsLUB) when s is BddAbove; likewise h_inf guards f(sInf s) = sInf(f '' s) with BddAbove s, but sInf s is only meaningful when s is BddBelow. As stated, the hypotheses impose conditions on sSup/sInf of sets for which those values are unconstrained junk (not bounded on the relevant side), so they do not correctly express 'preserves suprema of sets bounded above' / 'preserves infima of sets bounded below' as encoded by the gold's LeftOrdContinuous/RightOrdContinuous.

Missing [TopologicalSpace α] and [TopologicalSpace β] instances: OrderTopology is defined as OrderTopology (α) [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α], so writing [OrderTopology α] without a prior/declared [TopologicalSpace α] instance (unlike the gold, which explicitly includes [TopologicalSpace X] and [TopologicalSpace Y]) leaves the required topology instance unresolved.

Produced hypotheses explicitly require s.Nonempty and thus exclude the empty-set case, whereas gold's IsLUB/IsGLB-based LeftOrdContinuous/RightOrdContinuous also constrain behavior on the empty set when the domain has a bottom/top element respectively — a minor edge-case divergence.
